summary: Norway localization of Business Central 29. It covers Norwegian VAT codes, proportional VAT, electronic VAT returns and SAF-T export, remittance and OCR/KID banking, EHF and PEPPOL e-invoicing, recurring orders and payroll import. Use it for questions on local setup, fields added to W1 tables and local reports.
overview:
Norway adds a large layer for VAT and audit reporting. Fields such as VAT Code and VAT Number are added to journal, ledger, sales and purchase tables, and VAT Posting Setup gets proportional deduction fields. Codeunit 12 "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line" gets procedures for proportional deduction. Own objects cover SAF-T export (versions 1.20 and 1.30 on Learn) and electronic VAT return submission through ID-Porten with OAuth 2.0.

Banking and payments center on the remittance module (objects in the 15000000 range). It handles remittance accounts and agreements, payment orders, a waiting journal, return files and error pages. Vendor, Vendor Ledger Entry and Gen. Journal Line carry the remittance and KID fields. Sales & Receivables Setup holds KID setup, and OCR setup and import objects handle customer payments. SEPA export codeunit 1221 gets two new events.

Sales and e-services add Account Code and E-Invoice fields to customers, and GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields to sales, reminder and finance charge documents. Own codeunits create EHF files, and a separate PEPPOL 3.0 Norway set (codeunits 37350 and up) extends the PEPPOL format. Recurring orders, service documents, payroll integration and Norwegian report variants are also included. Learn documents these under "Norway local functionality [NO]" and the topic pages for each feature.
key_points: VAT: a single VAT Code field on journals and documents, plus proportional VAT deduction set in VAT Posting Setup (Calc. Prop. Deduction VAT, Proportional Deduction VAT %).
SAF-T: mapping setup, setup wizard, export card, data check and file generation for versions 1.20 and 1.30.
Electronic VAT return: submission and validation codeunits, OAuth 2.0 setup and VAT period pages.
Remittance: accounts, agreements, suggestions, payment orders, waiting journal, return file import and error pages for vendor payments.
KID and OCR: KID setup on Sales & Receivables Setup, OCR setup, import to the cash receipt journal and the OCR Journal - Test report.
EHF and PEPPOL: GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields, export codeunits for invoices, credit memos, reminders and finance charge memos, and PEPPOL 3.0 NO objects.
Recurring orders: recurring groups on blanket sales orders and the Create Recurring Orders batch job.
Application always Allowed in General Ledger Setup and User Setup lets entries be applied in closed periods.

areas.what: Adds Norwegian VAT handling: VAT Code and VAT Number fields on journal lines, VAT entries, VAT Posting Setup and VAT Reporting Code, and proportional deduction logic in the posting codeunit. Own objects cover SAF-T export and mapping, electronic VAT return submission, and VAT period pages. The VAT Statement report is changed for the non-deductible part.
areas.why: Learn describes proportional VAT for mixed use, one VAT code in journals, SAF-T files for the authorities and electronic VAT returns through ID-Porten.

areas.what: Adds the remittance module for vendor payments: remittance fields on Vendor, Vendor Templ., Vendor Ledger Entry and Purchase Header, payment order and waiting journal pages, suggestion, export, import and test reports. Also adds local vendor reports.
areas.why: Learn documents remittance accounts, agreements, suggestions, return files and error handling for electronic vendor payments.

areas.what: Adds GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields to customers and to sales, reminder and finance charge documents. Adds KID and E-Invoice path setup on Sales & Receivables Setup, and extends PEPPOL management and validation for reminders. Includes recurring orders objects and local customer reports.
areas.why: Learn covers EHF customer setup, KID numbers on sales documents and recurring orders.

areas.what: Adds Norwegian extensions on service headers, lines, archives, posted documents and Service Management Setup, plus Norwegian service shipment, invoice and credit memo reports. Supports EHF output for service documents.

Own codeunits check and export sales, service, reminder and finance charge documents as EHF files, with batch reports to create electronic documents. Also holds OCR setup, OCR payment import and the OCR journal test report.
areas.why: Learn describes EHF file creation for public sector customers and OCR payment setup and import.

areas.what: Extends SEPA credit transfer export with events and procedures that move lines to the waiting journal, and adds fields to Payment Export Data. Adds import of Pain002 and CAMT054 files, and regulatory reporting codes with a threshold in Bank Export/Import Setup.
areas.why: Learn describes exporting remittance payments through SEPA or local standards and importing payment returns.

areas.what: Adds a PEPPOL 3.0 format for Norway through an enum extension, management, subscriber, install and upgrade codeunits, and export codeunits for sales and service invoices and credit memos. Two XML ports produce the sales invoice and credit memo.
areas.why: Learn covers PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 and the E-Documents framework for Norway.

areas.what: Adds Enterpriseregister and a classification procedure to Company Information. Document-Print gets sales order printing procedures, and Company-Initialize gets Norwegian SEPA CT code procedures. SAF-T extensions add fields to source codes and company contact.
Adds the Application always Allowed field to User Setup and extends the Electronic VAT OAuth 2.0 setup. The LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets are changed.
areas.why: Learn explains that Application always Allowed lets users apply entries outside the allowed posting period.

areas.what: Adds payroll integration for importing payroll transactions into general journals, with extensions on the general journal and journal setup.
areas.why: Learn describes importing payroll transactions from Huldt & Lillevik Lønn and Visma through the Payroll Data Definitions extension.

areas.what: Adds a document tools codeunit and a SAF-T data classification procedure in the data classification codeunit.

issues: Overview says GLN is added to customers. The input adds only Account Code and E-Invoice to Customer (and Customer Templ.). GLN is added to the sales header, invoice and credit memo headers, the archive header, and the reminder and finance charge memo headers. The sentence has been reworded to match.

Small point, not changed: the Vendor table gets remittance fields but no KID field. KID is on Vendor Ledger Entry, Gen. Journal Line and the purchase headers. Read as a group, the overview sentence is still accurate.
